verdict.rationale: Asaas's own docs list subscriptions as an API feature and mention recurring Automatic Pix payments, so it has a first-party recurring billing capability. Nothing in the evidence documents plans, trials, upgrades or proration. Missing for 10: plan/price catalog objects, trial periods, upgrade/downgrade flows, proration logic, subscription API reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set up recurring subscription billing with plans, trials, upgrades, and proration

citations.quote: Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
When creating recurring Automatic Pix payments in MANUAL mode, provide the pixAutomaticAuthorizationId of an ACTIVE authorization.
